_doc: Battle Tower battle room (Sapphire 10x9, zone 15): Battle Subway yellow floor (set 330) with the battle field (2-7, 3-7) = the Subway's round gray floor texture b03_yuka_c stretched once over it (a gray square with a ring, as Sapphire's field); the doorway the opponent comes from (4-5, 1) is a recess of the back wall; the four lamp pillars in the corners (0,2), (9,2), (0,8), (9,8) = white machines machine02. Sapphire's two exit warps are (5,8) and (6,8) but only (5,8) has the arrow behaviour: both are the exit mat here. Opponent and attendant: story phase.
